rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for the American whiskey itself.

example.english: This bourbon has a lovely oaky flavor.
example.traditional: 呢支波本威士忌有陣好香嘅木桶味。
example.jyutping: ni1 zi1 bo1 bun2 wai1 si6 gei2 jau5 zan6 hou2 hoeng1 ge3 muk6 tung2 mei6

rows.note: Use this when referring to one serving or glass of bourbon rather than to the whiskey as a type.

example.english: Please give me a glass of bourbon.
example.traditional: 麻煩你畀我一杯波本，唔該。
example.jyutping: maa4 faan4 nei5 bei2 ngo5 jat1 bui1 bo1 bun2 m4 goi1
